rationale: Not a duplicate: although PO, gross ($4,300.00) and dates (19 days apart) align with prior invoice HL-3301, this invoice carries a distinct service period (2026-02-15/2026-03-14 vs 2026-02-01/2026-02-28) and the billed name normalises differently, so clause 8's five conditions are not all met — it is a legitimate recurring charge under clause 8.1. Price and quantity match the PO line exactly (1 MONTH @ $4,000.00), tax at the vendor's 7.5% recomputes to $300.00 exactly (clause 5), and no goods receipt is expected on a SERVICES PO (clause 1). No defects; $4,300.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
